refnamediv.refpurpose: Fit filter B(s)/A(s) to the complex frequency response H at frequency points F.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [B, A] = invfreqs(H, F, nB, nA) [B, A] = invfreqs(H, F, nB, nA, W) [B, A] = invfreqs(H, F, nB, nA, W, iter, tol, 'trace')

listitem.para: Frequency (must be the same length as H).
Order of the denominator polynomial A.
Order of the numerator polynomial B.
(optional) Vector of weights (must be the same length as F). Default is uniform weighting.
(optional) Number of iterations for refinement. Default is no iterations.
(optional) Tolerance for iterations. Default is no tolerance.
(optional) Enables tracing of the iterative process.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `invfreqs` function fits a rational transfer function B(s)/A(s) to the desired complex frequency response `H` at frequency points `F`. The orders of the numerator and denominator polynomials are specified by `nB` and `nA`, respectively. Optionally, the fit-errors can be weighted using the weights `W`. The function supports iterative refinement of the solution, specified by `iter` and `tol`.
Note: The core implementation of this function relies on `invfreq.sci`.
